name: incentrosdeportivos – Sports Facility Bookings
author: CTMD

sections.description:
Your residents look for the sports centre on the town council’s website. Show them what they need: free courts, courses with places and how busy the pool is right now.

incentrosdeportivos is the management software for municipal sports facilities in Spain (bookings, courses, memberships, access control and payments). This plugin brings that live information to the town council’s WordPress website, with no copying and no updating by hand.

What you can show

  • Court booking: availability for the next seven days, court by court, with the price. Paddle, tennis, football pitches, sports halls…
  • Courses and activities: groups with free places, timetable and monthly fee.
  • Live occupancy: how many people are in the gym or the pool right now, with how busy it is.

When a resident clicks to book, sign up or pay, the town council’s official portal opens in a new tab. Payments, residents’ prices and memberships stay in the portal, where they belong.

Made for public websites

  • Five languages: Spanish, Valencian/Catalan, Galician, Basque and English. It follows the language of the page.
  • Light and dark mode, and the town council’s colours.
  • No cookies, no tracking, no personal data: public information only.
  • Fast: the script loads asynchronously and only on the pages that use it.
  • Works with any theme and page builder: Gutenberg block, shortcode for Elementor, Divi or the classic editor, and a classic widget for sidebars.

Three ways to add it

  1. Block: search for “Sports bookings” in the editor. You see the live preview while you edit.
  2. Shortcode: [incentros vista="reservar"], [incentros vista="actividades"] or [incentros vista="aforo"].
  3. Classic widget: Appearance → Widgets → “Sports bookings”.

Optional shortcode attributes: entidad (town council), centro (centre number), instalacion (facility number), idioma (es, ca, gl, eu, en) and tema (claro, oscuro, auto).

Try it now

No account needed to try it: use the demo town council villademo, or click “Live Preview” at the top of this page.

More information and demo: incentrosdeportivos.es/integraciones/wordpress

External services

This plugin relies on the incentrosdeportivos service (https://incentrosdeportivos.es), run by OVERANT INTERNET, S.L., to display the data
of the town council configured in the settings. It is required: without it the plugin has nothing to show.

  • On pages that contain the block, the shortcode or the widget, the visitor’s browser loads the script https://incentrosdeportivos.es/widget.js,
    which inserts an iframe from https://incentrosdeportivos.es/widget/{identifier}. The iframe requests the public data of that town council
    (facilities, availability, courses and occupancy) from https://incentrosdeportivos.es/v1/.
  • In the block editor and on the settings page, the same iframe is shown as a preview to the logged-in editor.
  • Data sent: only what any web page request sends (IP address, browser user agent, referring page) plus the town council identifier and
    the options chosen in the block (view, centre, language, theme). No personal data, no cookies, no tracking.
  • Links in the widget open the town council’s portal on the same service, where the visitor can book and pay under its own terms.

Terms of use: https://incentrosdeportivos.es/aviso-legal/
Privacy policy: https://incentrosdeportivos.es/privacidad/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search for “incentrosdeportivos”).
  2. Go to Settings → incentrosdeportivos and enter your town council identifier: the one in your portal address (incentrosdeportivos.es/identifier). You will see a preview right there.
  3. Add the “Sports bookings” block, the shortcode or the widget to any page.

No account yet? Enter villademo to try it with the demo town council.
sections.faq:
Do I need an incentrosdeportivos account?

Yes. The plugin shows the data of a town council or sports board that manages its facilities with incentrosdeportivos. The identifier, centre and facility numbers are in its panel, under Configuración → Widget para la web. You can try everything with the demo identifier villademo.

Can residents book and pay from my website?

They see availability, places and prices on your website. Booking, signing up and paying happen in the town council’s official portal, which opens in a new tab: that is where residents sign in and see their own prices.

Does it set cookies or collect personal data?

No. It only shows public data (timetables, free places and occupancy) and does not set cookies or track visitors. See “External services” below.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi or the classic editor?

Yes. Use the shortcode [incentros] in the “Shortcode” element or widget of your page builder.

Can I show only one centre or one facility?

Yes: set the centre number in the block settings, or use centro="12" or instalacion="34" in the shortcode.

Can I limit the websites where it is shown?

Yes, from the town council panel (Configuración → Widget para la web → Dónde se puede mostrar).

Does it slow down my website?

No. The script is small, loads asynchronously and only on pages that contain the block, shortcode or widget.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: live preview of the widget inside the block editor.
  • New: preview on the settings page.
  • New: “Try the demo” button when no town council is set yet.
  • New: the widget follows the site language (Spanish, Catalan/Valencian, Galician, Basque, English).
  • Block updated to API version 3 for the iframed editor of recent WordPress versions.

1.0.0

  • First version: block, shortcode, classic widget and settings.
